name: Bigfoot
description: A large, hairy, bipedal humanoid creature reported throughout North America, particularly in the Pacific Northwest. One of the most extensively reported and culturally entrenched cryptids, with thousands of eyewitness accounts but no specimen accepted by mainstream science.

aliases.name: Skunk Ape
aliases.region: Florida and the Southeastern United States

origin: Reports span the contiguous United States, Alaska, and Canada. The densest, most studied clusters are in the temperate rainforests of the Pacific Northwest (northern California, Oregon, Washington, British Columbia). Secondary clusters occur in the Ohio River Valley, Appalachia, the Florida Everglades, and the Boreal forests of central Canada.
